_meta.file_purpose: Reusable execution presets consumed by selection.load_profiles().

quick_glossary.profile: Saved preset of hosts + tasks + timeout.
quick_glossary.host_query: Rule for picking hosts from inventory.
quick_glossary.tasks: Work items to run on each selected host.
quick_glossary.timeout: Maximum seconds allowed per task command.

profile_fields.description: Human-readable summary shown in --list-profiles and interactive menu.
profile_fields.host_query: Host selector expression; supports all or tag syntax (e.g. tags:production).
profile_fields.tasks: List of canonical/alias task names resolved by selection.build_task_list().
profile_fields.timeout: Per-task timeout override in seconds for this profile.

query_notes: Example: tags:lab,tags:dev selects hosts with either tag.

prod-maintenance.description: Run regular maintenance on production hosts

prod-health.description: Run system health checks on production hosts

docker-health.description: Run docker health check on docker hosts

full-health.description: Run system and docker health checks; docker checks are skipped on non-docker hosts

lab-maintenance.description: Run regular maintenance on lab/dev hosts only
